name: export-sftp-via-file-storage
summary: Delegate SFTP export to the file-storage-export service (managed credentials, no direct SFTP).
notes: Use file-storage-export rather than a direct SFTP call when egress/credential rotation is a concern. Hook secrets_schema: CLOSED shape (declared auth_secret key, additionalProperties: false) — nothing writes secrets back at runtime; the Secrets editor prefills the declared key as __change_me__.
